name: Adobe Photoshop CS6 (13.x)
summary: The classic 2012 release runs well through Wine for photo editing; keep GPU acceleration off.
notes:
Photoshop CS6 is one of the best-supported Adobe releases on Wine: installing, opening/saving PSD/JPEG/PNG/TIFF, layers, adjustment layers, filters, brushes, text and Camera Raw all work. You need the offline CS6 installer (Set-up.exe) and a licence/serial you already own; the Adobe sign-in and updater do not work, so install with the serial number, not with an Adobe ID trial that needs online activation.
After installing: Edit > Preferences > Performance > untick 'Use Graphics Processor' (the OpenGL/3D features and some GPU filters (Oil Paint, Blur Gallery, 3D) do not work). If the installer window is blank or the program crashes on start, run: lindos-compat recipes apply photoshop-cs6 --fresh and try again.
This recipe creates a 64-bit C:\ drive with the runtimes CS6 expects (Visual C++ 2008/2010, GDI+, ATM, MSXML, core fonts, RGB font smoothing) and reports Windows 7. The 32-bit Photoshop.exe inside 'Program Files (x86)' is also installed and can be used if a plug-in needs it.
Native alternatives on Lindos: GIMP, Krita, Photopea (web).
installer_hint: Set-up.exe from the CS6 package: lindos-run --prefix photoshop-cs6 ~/Downloads/Adobe\ CS6/Set-up.exe

alternatives.name: GIMP
alternatives.how: native, free: Lindos Settings > Apps > Store, or: apt install gimp
